name: Abyss
subtitle: Flying Titan
description: Abyss is an 800-cost aerial titan unit that attacks by sweeping a high-damage laser across the battlefield.

name: Arclight
subtitle: Medium Anti-Swarm Bot
description: Arclight is a 100-cost medium-ranged chaff clear unit that excels against light units like crawlers, fangs, and mustangs.

name: Crawler
subtitle: Light Melee Robot
description: Crawler is a 100-cost high-speed melee light unit featuring the most bodies per squad in the game.

name: Death Knell
subtitle: High Damage Titan
description: Death Knell is an 800-cost ranged titan unit that shoots up to 4 beams with ramping damage, one in each direction.

name: Fang
subtitle: Light All-Purpose Bot
description: Fang is a flexible 100-cost Ranged light unit that can serve as either chaff or Ranged DPS depending on its technologies.

name: Farseer
subtitle: Large support vehicle
description: Farseer is a fast-moving 300-cost long-ranged unit with plenty of anti-air and supportive capabilities.

name: Fire Badger
subtitle: Medium Anti-Swarm Tank
description: Fire Badger is a short-ranged 200-cost medium chaff clear unit with many ways to spread fire.

name: Fortress
subtitle: Giant Guard Robot
description: Fortress is a ranged 400-cost giant unit that can protect its team while dealing high damage to ground units.

name: Hacker
subtitle: Hacker Bot
description: Hacker is a 200-cost long-ranged unit that takes control of enemy units instead of dealing damage.

name: Hound
subtitle: Light Anti-Swarm Mech
description: Hound is a 100-cost short-ranged light unit that specializes in killing other light units, while still functioning as a weak form of chaff or a source of utility.

name: Marksman
subtitle: Long-Range Anti-Unit Bot
description: Marksman is a 100-cost long-ranged DPS unit that excels at sniping single targets from afar.

name: Melting Point
subtitle: Giant Anti-Unit Bot
description: Melting Point is a 400-cost giant unit that ramps up damage as it attacks, making it ideal against other giant and high-hp units.

name: Mountain
subtitle: Titan
description: Mountain is an 800-cost ranged titan unit that provides unmatched DPS combined with monstrous HP.

name: Mustang
subtitle: High-Speed All-Purpose Tank
description: Mustang is a 200-cost light unit with a fast attack that helps in both chaff clear and DPS.

name: Overlord
subtitle: Giant Aircraft
description: Overlord is a 500-cost long-ranged aerial giant unit that shoots a volley of missiles with overwhelming single-target damage and a small splash radius.

name: Phantom Ray
subtitle: Medium-sized Aircraft
description: Phantom Ray is a 200-cost short-ranged medium air unit with high DPS and cloaking technology.

name: Phoenix
subtitle: Long-Range Strike Aircraft
description: Phoenix is a 200-cost long-ranged aerial unit that excels at sniping single targets from afar.

name: Raiden
subtitle: Giant Aircraft
description: Raiden is a 400-cost aerial giant unit whose weapon always attacks up to 3 different targets.

name: Rhino
subtitle: Heavy Melee Bot
description: Rhino is a 200-cost melee tank unit that can deal massive damage if it reaches its victims

name: Sabertooth
subtitle: Heavy Tank
description: Sabertooth is a high-damage 200-cost tank that excels at deleting any unit its cannons target.

name: Sandworm
subtitle: Giant Melee Mech
description: Sandworm is a melee 400-cost giant unit that burrows underground to avoid damage while moving toward its prey.

name: Scorpion
subtitle: Heavy Anti-Swarm Robot
description: Scorpion is a tanky 300-cost DPS unit with a very low firing rate that hits a huge area, capable of taking out an entire pack of medium units in one shot.

name: Sledgehammer
subtitle: Heavy Tank
description: Sledgehammer is a 200-cost medium unit that is difficult to kill while providing a small amount of splash damage.

name: Steel Ball
subtitle: High-Speed Anti-Unit Bot
description: Steel ball is a fast, short-ranged 200-cost medium unit that can kill any ground target it attacks, provided it survives for a few seconds.

name: Stormcaller
subtitle: Heavy Rocket Launcher
description: Stormcaller is a fragile, super-long-ranged 200-cost artillery unit that excels against any slow-moving enemy from afar, but cannot defend itself in close range.

name: Tarantula
subtitle: Heavy Mech
description: Tarantula is a 200-cost short-ranged tank that serves as an early-game chaff clear unit and scales well with heavy investment.

name: Typhoon
subtitle: Heavy All-Purpose Mech
description: Typhoon is a 300-cost tanky ranged chaff clear unit that is strong against light units both on the ground and in the sky.

name: Void Eye
subtitle: Light High Damage Unit
description: Void eye is a 100-cost medium-ranged DPS unit whose role can change with a number of inexpensive transformative techs.

name: Vortex
subtitle: Medium Mech
description: Vortex is a 100-cost frontliner that specializes in killing medium units at mid-range.

name: Vulcan
subtitle: Giant Anti-Swarm Bot
description: Vulcan is a 400-cost giant unit that excels at clearing chaff and spreading fire from a medium-to-long range.

name: War Factory
subtitle: Titan Mobile Factory
description: War Factory is an 800-cost ranged titan unit with four independent high-power cannons that can research the ability to produce a variety of units during combat.

name: Wasp
subtitle: Light Aircraft
description: Wasp is a 200-cost short-ranged aerial chaff unit that can turn into a DPS threat with investment.

name: Wraith
subtitle: Heavy Aircraft
description: Wraith is a tanky 300-cost short-ranged aerial unit with 4 cannons that are strong against light units and shoot different targets.
